note: MCM 2016 D, control 54740, 22 PDF sheets whose running header prints "Control # 54740 N of 21", so printed page = PDF page - 1 and the printed document is 21 pages; PDF page 1 is the cover sheet plus the official Summary, and the reference list opens on PDF page 21 (printed page 20). 38 measured regions on 13 pages, of which one is the cover-sheet header and is excluded, leaving 37 exhibits: 36 figure rows and 1 table. The rows carry 17 of the figure numbers the paper could have used - the highest printed number is 19, and there is no Figure 5 and no Figure 12 - because the two exhibits that belong in those slots, the pair of topical-distribution pies on page 6 and the model-versus-Google-Trends pair on page 13, survive only as unnumbered (a)/(b) sub-captions and record caption numbering none. Twelve of the exhibits are multi-panel and account for 29 of the 36 rows: Figure 4 is five panels in two rows, Figure 1 and the front-page summary are three each, and Figures 6, 7, 8, 10, 15, 16, 18 plus both unnumbered exhibits are two each. The paper also prints a table as a figure: Figure 9 is a boxed two-column grid of R-squared values whose caption says "figure" while the very next sentence calls it "the above table". Citation is minimal - only Figure 1, Figure 3 and Figure 17 are ever named in the body, the last two inside one sentence - and 25 of the 37 exhibits are pointed at by nothing at all.
rules: 题注编号：除两处未编号图形外，全部印 "Figure N:"（冒号），共十七个展品行（含被当作图印出来的那张表）记 [caption.numbering]="Figure N:"；paper 跳过了 5 与 12 两个编号，但对应的图形确实存在 （p6 底部两张饼图、p13 中部两张折线），它们只有 (a)/(b) 子题注而无编号，故这两组各记 "none"，并在笔记里写明跳号。
题注位置：全部图形题注在图形下方（[caption.position]="below"），包括 Fig 9 那张表——它是唯一题注在表格下方的表，与常规表注在上相反，需照实记录。

多面板行按"分别测量、共用一条题注"处理（[caption.verbatim]、[mention.first_page]）：Fig 1 三栏、Fig 4 五栏（两行：3+2）、p1 摘要三栏、p6 两张饼图、p13 无编号两栏，以及 Fig 6/7/8/10/15/16/18 各两栏；题注只引在 bbox 最左的那一行，其余各行 caption_source=none。区域序号与阅读顺序常常相反（Fig 1 左栏是 r3、Fig 4 的 (a) 是 r3 而 (e) 是 r4），左右一律按 bbox 的 x 判断。

引用几乎全部缺席：正文只有三处带编号的引用（Figure 1 在 p4、Figure 3 与 Figure 17 同在 p16 的一句里），故 [mention.style] 只出现 "Figure 1"/"Figure 3"/"Figure 17" 三种拼写；其余用 "outlined below"、"shown in the above table"、"represented below"、"The results are shown below" 之类指代，记 [mention.count]=0、[mention.style]=[]。Figure 3 与 Figure 17 由同一句"…competing information (Figure 17)" 引用，两行共享同一 lead，笔记里说明这是同一句。
Fig 9 是被当作图印出来的表：题注叫 "Figure 9"，紧随其后的正文却写 "the above table"，区域是位图而不是矢量线框，故按表记录（[table.rule_style]="boxed"，这是全文唯一的满格表格，5 行 2 列、含表头带、表头下也有横线），题注在表格下方。
两处题注在文本层里是双栏子题注交错（p6 两张饼图、p13 两张折线），[caption.verbatim] 只能照抄规范化后的交错串（如 "(a) Circulation proportion (b) News type by user vol- of newspaper type in 1880."），这不是抄写错误而是排版顺序所致，笔记里已注明。

图形复用与错标（对照 [caption.verbatim] 与 [mention.first_page] 即可看出）：p1 摘要里的 (b) 就是 p13 的 Figure 11 同一张图，(c) 的子题注与 Figure 17 题注逐字相同；Fig 7(a) 是手绘阈值分布草图（无 x 轴、无刻度、无数字），(b) 是手绘带编号的有向网络，两者风格与其余 Excel 生成图完全不同，故 (a) 记 flowchart-or-schematic。Fig 12(b) 是 Google Trends 截图而非自绘图表。
